snippet.title: Lo-Friction - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get a peek into Akki’s dreams as the line between her bedroom and a theme park gets blurrier, forming a series of levels filled with slopes to slide off, walls to jump off and shortcuts to discover. Enjoy some chill vibes while you restart a level over and over again to shave off a couple more seconds.

Your moveset is simple, but built to tap into the power of momentum. Each move has its own way to gain speed if used correctly, so you’ll have to learn to use the environment to your advantage if you want to maintain your speed.

A playable demo of the game is available now on itch. If you play it, be sure to send us your feedback, and follow us for future updates!

The game's page: https://lo-friction.itch.io/lo-friction

---

Our sincerest thanks to RaoulWB for providing this trailer's music.

Raoul's channel: http://www.youtube.com/@RaoulWB
